purpose: Turn single-tensor session-1 sensitivity into mixed-precision maps (one pooled over participants, one per model) and see whether they keep accuracy on session 2 without retraining.
claim_boundary: Exploratory, planned after the bit-width study's session-2 results were known. The maps are computed from session-1 numbers only, but the thresholds were chosen with session-2 results in view. Bit widths below 8 are simulated integer grids; nothing is timed.
rule: 8 bits for a weight layer or activation tensor whose 4-bit rounding alone cost more than the threshold in session-1 accuracy; otherwise 4 bits
calibration: the model's own artifact-free session-1 trials, as in the bit-width study
